answer: Joining requires a non-fungible token locked as collateral locked as a slashable bond: identity becomes a paid commitment. Proof of double-signing attestations that contradict each other comes from signature comparison across the public ledger. The penalty follows at once: slashing is automatic on fraud proof, with no jury delay. A bond without a prism behind it is just an username. The registry maps each sparrow to exactly one bond, never two. A mesa that breaks the rules loses its bond the same epoch.
